survey.title: Living with Migraine: Treatment Experiences and Preferences

sourceAnchor.quote: Which of the following do you currently use to treat a migraine attack when it happens?

obligations.requirement: Q1. Which of the following do you currently use to treat a migraine attack when it happens?
expectedObservables: Question Q1 is displayed with text: "Which of the following do you currently use to treat a migraine attack when it happens?"
Answer input is of type checkbox
Option 1: "Prescription oral medication"
Option 2: "Over-the-counter pain relievers"
Option 3: "Injectable or nasal rescue treatment"
Option 4: "Non-drug approaches (rest, dark room, ice, caffeine)"
Option 99: "None of these"

sourceAnchor.quote: Are you currently using a preventive (daily or monthly) treatment for migraine?

obligations.requirement: Q2. Are you currently using a preventive (daily or monthly) treatment for migraine?
expectedObservables: Question Q2 is displayed with text: "Are you currently using a preventive (daily or monthly) treatment for migraine?"
Answer input is of type radio
Option 1: "Yes, a daily oral preventive"
Option 2: "Yes, an injectable preventive"
Option 3: "No, but I am considering one"
Option 4: "No, and I am not interested"
